schema.description: A report authored on the API Manager's Reports page. definition is JavaScript that runs in a sandboxed frame in the viewer's browser, calls OBP through the API Manager with the viewer's own access, and emits rows; parameters describes the inputs the viewer fills in before a run. Never served to the public.

slug.description: Short identifier. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

description.example: Counts the accounts the viewer can see at each bank.
description.description: What the report shows and who it is for.

definition.example: async function run(params, obp) { const b = await obp.get('/obp/v6.0.0/banks'); return { columns: ['bank_id', 'name'], rows: b.banks.map(x => [x.bank_id, x.full_name]) }; }
definition.description: JavaScript defining async function run(params, obp) that returns { columns, rows } or { items }.

parameters.description: JSON array of parameter fields: name, label, type (string | number | date | bank_id | boolean), default, required.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 time of the last save.
